changelogs.title: The 'Dashboard' update
changelogs.description: Mostly about finding things. The Character and Side Dashboards were pretty much empty shells with a grid on them, so this update actually fills them in. The site also works properly with a keyboard now, and search engines can finally read it.
changes: Added the community tier list to the Character Dashboard, so you can see where everyone sits without opening another page
Added a Recently Updated list, so you can tell what changed since you last looked
Added a Pages That Need Work list, showing which characters still need writing and exactly which sections are missing. Pick one you know and go
Added a Start Here reading path to the Side Dashboard. Six guides in the order that actually makes sense if you are new, instead of a wall of links
Added a How to Contribute section explaining how editing works. Short version: anyone signed in can propose an edit, a reviewer checks it, and you cannot break anything
Added live wiki stats, so you can see how many pages, edits and contributors there are
Made the whole site usable with just a keyboard, including a skip to content link so you do not have to tab through the entire sidebar on every page
Added proper screen reader support. Buttons now say what they do, and collapsible menus say whether they are open
Made the site respect reduced motion if you have that turned on in your OS
Added a sitemap and a robots.txt, so Google can index the wiki properly instead of guessing. Staff pages are left out of both, so admin tools will not turn up in search results

Fixed what happens when a page gets retired. It used to stay fully readable at its old link forever, and now it shows a short "this page has been archived" notice instead. Old Discord links still work, they just tell you the truth
Made the dashboard text, the site tagline, the page titles that show in Discord previews and the Game Info panel all editable without touching code
Made character page details editable too, so things like the work in progress flag, archetype, tier and release date
Cleaned up the owner tools page, because ten tools in one long scroll had stopped being findable

changelogs.title: The 'Maintenance' update
changelogs.description: Mostly behind-the-scenes tooling so the site can be run without editing code. The one thing you'll actually notice: character links now show that character's portrait when you paste them in Discord.
changes: Paste a character link in Discord and the preview now shows that character's portrait instead of the wiki logo
Found and reported a broken portrait on Disaster Plants — the image had been dead on the page for over a month
Everything else this update is admin tooling: managing roles, adding and reordering pages, editing the FAQ and credits, and handling account deletion requests without going into the database by hand
The Credits list on the main dashboard and the Collaborators page were two separate lists that had drifted apart — they're now the same list

changelogs.title: The 'Link Previews & Blog' update
changelogs.description: Wiki links now show a proper preview when you paste them in Discord instead of showing nothing, and the site has a blog.
changes: Paste a wiki link in Discord and it now shows a proper preview with the page name and a description, instead of just a bare link
The site has a blog now — find it in the sidebar under Site Info, with the latest posts also showing on the main dashboard
Small site updates that aren't big enough for a full version can now be posted as short notes, and show up in the Update Log
Fixed the Edit button on every system page rendering off the side of the screen on desktop, where you couldn't reach it
Behind the scenes: every character and system page is now built from one shared template instead of 30 near-identical copies, so pages stay consistent and new ones are far less work to add

changelogs.title: The 'Notifications Actually Work' update
changelogs.description: The inbox bell has never worked. It does now, so you'll finally hear back about the edits you submit. Plus the mod page is usable on a phone, and the site has a few pages it was missing.
changes: The inbox bell in the sidebar now actually works — it has been showing 'No new messages' to everyone this whole time, no matter what. Every notification you were ever sent is still there and will show up now
You'll get told when your edit is approved or declined, when staff open a discussion on it, and when they first reply — no more checking back manually to find out
The little red dot for unread messages works too (it was reading from the wrong place and never appeared)
Marking a message as read now sticks instead of coming back unread next time

The moderation page is properly usable on a phone now — the discussion panel was squished into two tiny columns, one of the view buttons ran off the edge of the screen, and the header ate most of the screen before you could see anything
Long technical diffs no longer run off the side of the screen
Added a proper 404 page, so a broken link now lands somewhere with the menu still on it instead of a blank error
Added a footer with a privacy policy and the site's license
Behind the scenes: the site now tests itself automatically every time anything changes, so breakages get caught before they go live

changelogs.title: The 'Actual Mobile' update
changelogs.description: A big pass on the review system so nothing you submit ever just disappears, plus finishing off mobile support for the rest of the site.
changes: Added a new 'Recent Changes' page — see every approved edit across the whole wiki in one place
Added a new 'My Submissions' page — see every edit you've submitted and what happened to it (pending, approved, declined, or withdrawn), no need to ask a reviewer anymore
You can now edit or take back your own pending submission yourself
Reviewers can now ask for specific changes on a submission instead of just approving it, rejecting it, or rewriting it themselves — you'll see clearly when this happens
Reviewers can now see a page's past versions and roll one back with a single click if something goes wrong
Declined and withdrawn submissions are no longer deleted outright, so there's a record of what was tried before
Pending edits in the review queue now show roughly what changed (and how big the edit is) before a reviewer even opens them
Frame data and stat changes now show up as a real, readable comparison in the review queue instead of two walls of raw text
Added mobile navigation to the page history view (was missing entirely)
Fixed the media library in the editor being basically unusable on mobile
Made buttons across the site easier to tap on phones
Fixed a bug where staff with more than one role could randomly get logged out of the review queue
Fixed voting on a submission resetting your current view back to the top
Fixed a stale button state after posting in a ticket discussion
Fixed the 'Revoke Access' button in the owner tools, which never actually worked
Fixed a bug in the ticket-merging tool that could silently delete unrelated content when merging multiple pending edits to the same page
Fixed a bug where going back to the review page after visiting another page could wrongly show 'access denied'
Various under-the-hood security improvements to how submitted content is displayed to reviewers

changelogs.title: The 'Mobile Support' update
changelogs.description: A dedicated pass making both the reader-facing wiki and the contributor editor actually usable on phones.
changes: Added mobile navigation to the homepage and all character pages (previously missing entirely below 1024px width)
Centralized the mobile nav code so it behaves consistently across every page type
Character page titles now use a proper heading level for accessibility
Fixed hover tooltips (frame data, callouts) not working at all on touch devices
Fixed tooltips rendering off-screen when they had a lot of content
Fixed images/videos/embeds either overflowing the screen or shrinking down to nothing on mobile
Fixed the character profile box being a different width than the rest of the page on mobile
Fixed a bug where low-resolution character portraits pushed profile stats outside their box
Reduced oversized text and padding across the site so mobile pages don't feel as cramped
Rewrote the tier list editor's drag-and-drop so it actually works on touch devices (it was completely broken before)
Added auto-scroll while dragging in the tier list editor, so you can drag across a long list on a small screen
Rewrote the content block editor's drag-and-drop (adding/reordering blocks) to support touch
Fixed the editor's live preview looking narrower/more cramped than the actual live page
Fixed the editor's toolbar buttons overflowing off-screen on narrow phones
Fixed frame data timeline phases becoming impossible to tap on narrow screens
Cleaned up ~40 leftover inline styles in the tier list editor

changelogs.title: The 'Tear Down and Rebuild' update
changes: Tore down the site and rebuilt it page by page
Made system pages, site info, and guides editable (except for a select few)
Changed how the editor works foundationally, making many QOLs and features possible
Implemented a better authentication system
Added a way to view the history of a page, who changed it, and who accepted the revision
Made the admin panel actually usable and functional
Added a way for reviewers to intercept a revision to fix things such as grammar or formatting errors (trust-based system)
Highlighted the changes in a submission (diff view)
Fixed smart merge being admin-exclusive
Added the 'Trusted Editor' role to the site with benefits
Improved Local Drafts so that it won't create new redundant tabs, alongside a better saving system
Fixed a bug where auto-save would wipe everything
Fixed lazy rendering somehow not working with videos, causing video-heavy pages to slow down
Moved to a modular CSS styling architecture
Reworked the right sidebar that is used for quick navigation
Appropriate color accents now apply based on the character color code
Added 'Pick if you like vs Avoid if you dislike' table to every character page
Made Accordion an actual thing that can be used
Improved the Divider component
Added a way to caption videos
Made webm/mp4 supported in the skill entry
Added Damage Type Metadata to skill entry
Added quick keys/combos for styling stuff
Added a time passed stat to submissions
Opening a ticket now auto-moves you to that ticket to start reviewing
Reworded and explained the Confidence level better
Added Writing Guide to Site Info pages
Renamed Disaster Plant to Disaster Plants
Spent money on Supabase so everything won't be gone
